scoring_justification: Recompute from raw intermediates is infeasible because the agent's output contract only includes final computed tilt/defect/beta values, not the input intensity values or the equations; the checker therefore compares the reported numbers to the paper's gold values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported reference tilt angles, gauche defect percentages, and twist angles for DT and ODT monolayers on Zn.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Tables 5 and 6 (tilt angles and defects) and Table 4 (twist angles).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values are copied exactly from the source tables as reported by the authors.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the author's actual measured/computed physical quantities; they serve as the authoritative reference for reproduction.

outputs.description: Computed orientation parameters (tilt angles, gauche defect percentages, twist angles) for decanethiol and octadecanethiol monolayers on zinc.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the reported values against reference data within specified tolerances.
